title: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-7 external antenna
summary: 外天线 SKU；当前CAD为板载天线版本参考，RF机械件未核实。7 英寸 800×480；16 MiB Flash / 8 MiB PSRAM。

display.controller: RGB panel; no invented command ID

components: GT911@5D/14 address strapIRQ4, resetCH422EX1; no touch on30406
BL CH422EX2;TF SPI CLK12 MOSI11 MISO13 CS EX4low

facts.label: 版次、来源冲突与范围
value: Original7-inch hardware differs from7B/7C and usesCH422G. Physical datasheet mode bits0/2/4/7 conflict with somevendor driver definitions; staticI/O subset followsdatasheet, rejects scan/sleep.
Selected officialSD example usesSPI. No nativeSDMMC behavior is invented from a documentation mention.64MiB image reachesSPIcard model; original factory has0 nativeSDMMC traffic at5s.
Touch original factory, non-touchLVGL example and external-antenna reference each execute5s to originalboot-stage stop with blackframe, noRGBframes. ExternalRF hardware support has not been proven.
Non-touch has an official LVGL example but no proven factory image in retainedREADME. TouchFactory is not assigned to non-touchSKU.
ExternalantennaSKU35892 uses separately recorded exactSKU option but retainedCAD is onboardantenna baseline; externalRF geometry unknown.

limitations: All native source topology preserved without scale fitting. Native materials are not calibrated hardware color.
Physical3D switch/connector calibration is not established; no guessed button targets or connected cables. Workbench inputs remain separately available.
No hardware fit, optical alignment, browser WebGL or full factory application acceptance claim.

SKU35892 external-antenna option is documented by exact storefront option mapping. Retained native CAD depicts onboard antenna version; externalRF module/antenna mechanical geometry is UNKNOWN and is not claimed as matched.

Source native LCD/FPC/carrier envelope differs from published nominal glass/metal dimensions; all native components are retained without fitting. Small fastener/component completeness remains unverified.

value.scope: Exact retained official resource pages and pinned upstreamboardtrees. No generic platformimage assigned; source support does not provebinary compatibility.

facts.notes: Runtimeobservation is simulator-derived, not manufacturercompatibility assurance.
